summary.text: MICASA AS is an Aksjeselskap (limited company) registered at Storgaten 17, 3126 TØNSBERG, whose registered activity is investment in, operation and sale of real estate, plus investments in shares, securities and other companies. The company had 5 employees in the register as of 2023-09-12 and a share capital of 126500000.00 NOK, which the claims state as 126 500 000 NOK. Its latest filed annual accounts are for 2025, where the group accounts show total operating income of 53865049 NOK, an operating result of -21320685 NOK and an annual result of -22049431 NOK. Daglig leder (managing director) Steinar Krüger is listed, Thomas Holst is chair of the board, and Trond Arvid Ramski is a board member, with CEDRA NORGE AS as auditor as of 2025-10-10. The company is not in bankruptcy, being wound up or under compulsory dissolution, and it is not part of a group. Recent registry updates include a change to the business address on 2026-08-12 and a change to the latest filed accounts year to 2025 on 2026-05-30.
